claims: Assess and manage moderate to severe pain, titrating analgesics (e.g., opioid or acetaminophen) to patient comfort.
Continue heparin infusion at current rate and monitor anticoagulation with aPTT/anti-Xa per protocol.
Monitor hemoglobin/hematocrit for further decline and transfuse if clinically indicated.
Monitor platelet count for trends and evaluate for heparin-induced thrombocytopenia if platelets decline.
Recheck serum potassium and replete if below normal, given mild hypokalemia.
Assess and optimize nutrition, given Braden nutrition score indicating probable inadequacy.
Implement aspiration and fall precautions; keep head of bed elevated as appropriate and assist with mobility.
Monitor vital signs and oxygen saturation, with alarms set appropriately, and adjust oxygen therapy to maintain SpO2 above target.
Perform medication reconciliation and review need for ongoing DVT prophylaxis with heparin infusion.
Maintain ongoing dextrose 5% infusion at current rate and monitor glucose as needed.
